content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HNBGU Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University (HNBGU) for temporary teaching positions in Srinagar Garhwal, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by HNBGU?
faq.answer: HNBGU has advertised for the post of Guest Faculty in Rural Technology, Agricultural Extension Education, and Communication under the School of Agriculture & Allied Science.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty position in the Department of Rural Technology for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must meet the minimum eligibility criteria required for the post of Assistant Professor in accordance with the prevailing UGC norms and guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application mode is via advance email submission followed by a Walk-in Interview. Selection is done through application screening and the walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to send applications by email?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their applications by email to the Dean, School of Agriculture & Allied Science up to 7 October 2026 before attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 8 October 2026 at 10:30 AM in the Department of Rural Technology, Chauras Campus, HNB Garhwal University.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University for this temporary guest faculty position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or remuneration for this post?
faq.answer: The salary and remuneration for the selected candidate will be provided strictly as per the prevailing rules and guidelines of HNB Garhwal University.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the official notification and website?
faq.answer: Candidates can check all official details by visiting the university website at www.hnbgu.edu.in and reviewing the official notification PDF available online.
